svg.title: The dashed parabola y equals 2 x squared minus 8x plus 6 crosses the x-axis at 1 and 3 and has its lowest point at 2, minus 2. Its reciprocal y equals 1 over f of x is drawn solid in three branches, split by dashed vertical asymptotes x equals 1 and x equals 3. The outer branches lie above the x-axis, rise steeply next to the asymptotes and flatten towards the x-axis further out. The middle branch lies below the x-axis, falls steeply next to both asymptotes and has its highest point at 2, minus one half, directly above the parabola's lowest point.
